content.subject: Quick thought on your tech approach
content.draft_text:
Hi Chermaine,
You noted Episode Six values flexibility, scalability, and real‑world problem solving. That suggests your finance team spends significant time reconciling data across systems, though I could be mistaken. We run a rule‑based engine that reads transaction feeds and posts matched entries to your ledger. I’m curious. Would you have 15 minutes next week to discuss?
